Lawsuit Challenges Paid Early Access to President's Truth Social Posts

Two media groups have filed a lawsuit against Trump Media & Technology Group, challenging a new service that offers paying customers early access to President Trump's posts on Truth Social. The lawsuit alleges that this subscription offer, reportedly costing up to $100,000 a month, aims to sell privileged access to information generated in the president's official capacity. The plaintiffs seek to prevent the exclusive release of official government information on the platform, arguing it violates the Constitution and the First Amendment's guarantee of equal access to presidential pronouncements.
